home_tagline_body: A portfolio management lab with real Indonesian stock prices.
app_simulation_notice: Simulation. No real money and no real trades.
language_unknown_error: The form sent "{value}" in the field "{field}", but Portolab is only available in {languages}. Choose one of them in the language switch.
language_page_body: Choose a language with the switch at the top of the page.
language_rejected_title: The language could not be changed
language_not_text_error: The form sent a value of type {type} in the field "{field}" instead of text. Choose {languages} in the language switch.
language_missing_error: The form sent no language in the field "{field}". Choose {languages} in the language switch.
app_not_found_body: This address does not exist in Portolab. Check the address again, or go back to the home page.
app_unexpected_error_body: Portolab could not show this page. Try reloading the page. If the problem continues, tell your lecturer.
market_data_delay_notice: Prices are delayed by about {minutes} minutes and come from {source}. The latest price was recorded at {time} WIB.
market_data_empty_body: Portolab is fetching its first prices now. Reload this page in a moment to see them.
market_data_update_failed_notice: Portolab could not update the prices at {time} WIB, so the prices below are the last ones it stored.
market_data_empty_failed_body: Portolab has no prices yet, because its latest attempt to fetch them at {time} WIB failed.
market_data_one_stale_price_notice: Portolab could not update the price of {codes} at {time} WIB, so the {codes} price below is the last one it stored.
market_data_several_stale_prices_notice: Portolab could not update the prices of {codes} at {time} WIB, so their prices below are the last ones it stored.
market_data_one_missing_price_notice: Portolab has no price for {codes} yet, because its latest attempt to fetch it at {time} WIB failed.
market_data_several_missing_prices_notic: Portolab has no prices for {codes} yet, because its latest attempt to fetch them at {time} WIB failed.
trading_missing_rules_error: Portolab cannot take this order yet, because it has not recorded the rules of IDX for the trading day of the order. Tell your lecturer, so that the rules can be added.
trading_missing_costs_error: Portolab cannot take this order yet, because it lacks a record of the broker fee or of the final tax on sales for the trading day of the order. Tell your lecturer, so that the missing rates can be added.
trading_missing_universe_error: Portolab cannot take this order yet, because it has not recorded which stocks are in the LQ45 on the trading day of the order, and Portolab lets you buy only the stocks of the LQ45. Tell your lecturer, so that the stocks can be added.
trading_no_price_error: Portolab has no price for {code} yet, so it cannot check the order. Try again after the next update of prices brings a price for {code}.
trading_outside_universe_error: {code} is not in the LQ45 on {date}, and Portolab lets you buy only the stocks of the LQ45 of the trading day. Choose a stock that is in the LQ45 on that day.
trading_too_few_returns_error: {code} has {returns}, but Portolab computes the measures of a portfolio only when each of its stocks has {minimum}. If {code} keeps a close at the end of every month and stays in the LQ45, you can buy it after the update of the price history that stores the close of the first trading day of {month}. Portolab must also have recorded the rules of IDX and which stocks are in the LQ45 for the day of the purchase.
trading_outside_limits_error: The field "{field}" holds "{value}", but IDX rejects that price for {code} on {date} by its auto rejection limits. They allow a price at most {upper} above and {lower} below the reference price of {reference}, and each end of the range is the nearest valid price inside those limits. IDX sets the reference price from the latest close of {code} before that day. Choose a price from {lowest} to {highest}.
trading_off_tick_error: The field "{field}" holds "{value}", but IDX accepts prices from {from} to below {to} only in steps of {tick}, the tick size of that range. Choose {below} or {above}, the nearest valid prices.
trading_off_tick_top_error: The field "{field}" holds "{value}", but IDX accepts prices of {from} and above only in steps of {tick}, the tick size of that range. Choose {below} or {above}, the nearest valid prices.
trading_purchase_cost_error: Buying {lots} of {code} at {price} costs {cost}, which is {value} for the shares and {fee} for the broker fee, but your available cash is {available}.
trading_one_purchase_sets_aside_cash_err: Your open buy order sets aside {setAside} of your cash of {cash}, and it returns that amount to your available cash if you cancel it or it ends without filling.
trading_several_purchases_set_aside_cash: Your {count} open buy orders set aside {setAside} of your cash of {cash}, and each returns its part to your available cash if you cancel it or it ends without filling.
trading_largest_purchase_error: The largest order that your available cash pays for at {price} is {lots}.
trading_highest_lot_price_error: Your available cash pays for {smallestOrder} of a stock only at a price of at most {highest}.
trading_below_minimum_price_error: Your available cash does not pay for {smallestOrder} of any stock, even at {minimum}, the lowest price that IDX accepts.
trading_price_rose_error: Portolab did not fill your market order to buy {lots} of {code}, because the price rose from {checkedPrice} to {price} while the order waited. At {price} the order costs {cost}, which is {value} for the shares and {fee} for the broker fee, but your available cash was {available}.
trading_sale_shares_error: This order sells {lots} of {code}, and you hold {held}.
trading_one_sale_sets_aside_shares_error: Your open sell order sets aside {setAside} of {code} until it fills, expires, or you cancel it.
trading_several_sales_set_aside_shares_e: Your {count} open sell orders set aside {setAside} of {code} until they fill, expire, or you cancel them.
trading_no_shares_error: This order sells {lots} of {code}, but you hold no shares of {code}, and you can sell only shares that you hold. Check the stock, and whether you meant to buy it.
trading_one_sale_frees_shares_error: You can sell more shares of {code} once you cancel that order or it expires.
trading_several_sales_free_shares_error: You can sell more shares of {code} once you cancel one of those orders or one of them expires.
trading_no_price_history_error: Portolab has not stored a complete month of the price history of {instrument} yet, so it cannot count whether {code} has the monthly returns that the measures of a portfolio need. Try again after the next update of the price history stores it.
trading_no_reference_close_error: IDX sets the range of prices of a limit order from the latest close of {code} before the trading day of the order, but Portolab has no final close of {code} for {date} yet. A limit order becomes possible once an update of the price history stores that close, if {code} traded on {date}, or once Portolab has a price of {code} from the trading day of the order. A market order needs no limit.
trading_lots_not_whole_error: The field "{field}" takes a whole number of lots, such as {example}, but it holds "{value}". Write the number in digits, with or without "{separator}" between groups of digits as the example shows.
trading_sell_for_cash_error: This order needs {shortfall} more than your available cash, and selling shares that you hold adds to that cash.
trading_one_sale_adds_cash_error: Your open sell order of {codes} brings cash when it fills.
trading_several_sales_add_cash_error: Your {count} open sell orders of {codes} bring cash when they fill.
app_empty_field_error: The field "{field}" is empty, but Portolab needs it. Fill it in.
app_not_text_error: The form sent a value of type {type} in the field "{field}" instead of text. Reload the page and fill in the form again.
app_too_long_error: The field "{field}" holds at most {maximum} characters, but it has {length}. Shorten it.
app_far_too_long_error: The field "{field}" has {length} characters, far more than any field of Portolab takes. Fill it in with the text that it asks for.
app_too_large_form_body: This form has {size}, but Portolab accepts a form of at most {maximum}. This happens when a very long text is pasted into a field. Open the form again and fill in each field with a shorter text.
app_too_large_unstated_form_body: This form has more than {maximum}, which is the most that Portolab accepts in a form. This happens when a very long text is pasted into a field. Open the form again and fill in each field with a shorter text.
accounts_forgot_password_notice: Forgot your password? A student asks the lecturer to reset it, and a lecturer asks the person who runs this Portolab server.
accounts_wrong_credentials_error: Portolab found no account with this username and password. Check both and try again. After {failures} wrong attempts within {minutes} minutes, Portolab blocks the username for a while. The block stops anyone who tries to guess the password.
accounts_username_blocked_error: Portolab blocks passwords for "{username}" until {time} WIB, because it received {failures} wrong passwords for it within {minutes} minutes. The block stops anyone who tries to guess the password. Try again after that time.
accounts_address_blocked_error: Portolab blocks passwords from your network until {time} WIB, because it received {failures} wrong passwords from it within {minutes} minutes. The block stops anyone who tries to guess passwords. Try again after that time.
accounts_first_setup_body: Welcome to Portolab. Give your name, choose your own password, and agree to the privacy notice to finish your account.
accounts_new_password_body: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
accounts_lecturer_name_hint: Your students see this name on each class that you teach.
accounts_password_hint: At least {minimum} characters. A short sentence that only you know is long enough and easy to remember.
accounts_password_too_short_error: The field "{field}" needs at least {minimum} characters, but it has {length}. Each extra character makes a password much harder to guess, so choose a longer one, such as a short sentence.
accounts_passwords_differ_error: The field "{field}" differs from the new password. Type the same password in both fields.
accounts_consent_label: I agree to the privacy notice
accounts_consent_missing_error: Portolab stores your data only with your agreement. Read the privacy notice, then tick "{field}".
accounts_consented_notice: You agreed to the privacy notice on {time} WIB.
accounts_password_changed_notice: Portolab saved your new password and signed you out on every other device.
accounts_wrong_current_password_error: The password in the field "{field}" is wrong. Type it again. After {failures} wrong attempts within {minutes} minutes, Portolab blocks your username for a while. The block stops anyone who tries to guess the password.
accounts_refused_form_body: The form came from another site, or the browser did not say where it came from. Portolab refuses such a form, so that no other site can act in your name. Open Portolab directly and send the form again.
accounts_privacy_intro_body: Portolab is a simulation of portfolio management for classes. It stores only what a class needs, and it asks for your agreement before you start to use it.
accounts_privacy_username_body: Your username, which you sign in with.
accounts_privacy_name_body: Your name, so that the lecturer of a class knows whose work it sees, and so that students know who teaches their class.
accounts_privacy_password_body: Your password, only as a hash that cannot be turned back into the password.
accounts_privacy_classes_body: The classes that you teach or joined, and your simulated work in each class that you joined: your cash, your holdings, and your orders.
accounts_privacy_consent_body: The time when you agreed to this notice.
accounts_privacy_session_body: For each device where you are signed in, a cookie that keeps you signed in. Portolab stores only a hash of it, and the session ends after {days} days without a visit.
accounts_privacy_address_body: The address of your network, in memory only, for {minutes} minutes after each wrong password, wrong code of a class, or request for a new account from it, to stop anyone from guessing passwords and codes or from flooding a class with accounts.
accounts_privacy_language_body: A cookie with the language that you chose, which stays in your browser.
accounts_privacy_not_stored_body: Portolab stores no email address, no phone number, and nothing about your real finances. It uses no tracking and no advertising, and it gives your data to no one.
accounts_privacy_lecturer_body: The lecturer of a class sees the name, the username, and the work of each student in it. Students do not see the data of other students.
accounts_privacy_server_body: The person who runs this Portolab server can read everything that it stores, because they keep its database.
accounts_privacy_rights_body: Indonesia's Law Number 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection gives you the right to see, correct, and delete your data, and to withdraw your agreement. Portolab keeps your data until the person who runs this server deletes it, so ask them for any of these.
accounts_sign_out_body: Sign out of Portolab on this device.
accounts_username_hint: You sign in with it. It has {minimum} to {maximum} characters from {characters}.
accounts_username_error: The field "{field}" takes {minimum} to {maximum} characters from {characters}, but it holds "{value}". Choose a username, such as budi.santoso.
home_join_link: Join a class with its code
classes_no_taught_classes_body: You teach no class yet. Create one below, then share its code with your students.
classes_no_joined_classes_body: You are in no class. Join one with the code that your lecturer gave you.
classes_join_link: Join a class with its code
classes_starting_cash_hint: The virtual cash in whole rupiah that each student starts with.
classes_starting_cash_error: The field "{field}" takes a whole number of rupiah, such as {example}, but it holds "{value}". Write the amount in digits, with or without "{separator}" between groups of digits as the example shows.
classes_starting_cash_range_error: The field "{field}" takes {minimum} to {maximum}, but it holds "{value}". Less cash buys too few lots for a portfolio, and the maximum keeps every sum in a class exact. Choose an amount between the two.
classes_share_notice: Share the code or the address with your students. Each student who joins starts with {cash} in virtual cash.
classes_local_network_notice: You opened Portolab at "{host}", which only this computer can open. So the address for joining leads to this computer on its network, which phones on the same Wi-Fi network can open. When a phone cannot open it, the firewall of this computer or the Wi-Fi network blocks the connection. Allow the connection in the firewall, or use a network that lets devices reach each other, such as the hotspot of a phone.
classes_several_networks_notice: This computer is on several networks, so the page shows the address on each, under the name of its connection. Give your students the address on the network that their phones use.
classes_no_network_notice: Phones cannot open Portolab yet, because you opened it at "{host}", which only this computer can open, and this computer is on no network. Connect it to the Wi-Fi network of the class, then reload this page for the address that your students join with. Each student who joins starts with {cash} in virtual cash.
classes_student_notice: Signs in as "{username}". Joined on {time} WIB.
classes_joined_notice: You joined this class on {time} WIB.
classes_starting_cash_notice: You start with {cash} in virtual cash.
classes_reset_body: Portolab gives {name}, who signs in as "{username}", a temporary password and signs them out on every device. At the next sign-in, they choose a new password.
classes_temporary_password_notice: Give {name} this temporary password. It works until they choose a new one.
classes_join_body: Enter the code that your lecturer gave you.
classes_malformed_code_error: The field "{field}" takes the code of a class, which has {length} letters and digits without {lookalikes}, but it holds "{code}". Check the code with your lecturer.
classes_unknown_code_error: The field "{field}" holds "{code}", but no class has this code. Check the code with your lecturer and try again.
classes_join_blocked_error: Portolab blocks codes from your network until {time} WIB, because it received {failures} wrong codes from it within {minutes} minutes. The block stops anyone who tries to guess the code of a class. Try again after that time.
classes_lecturer_join_error: Only students join a class, and you are signed in as a lecturer. To join as a student, sign out first.
classes_lecturer_join_title: A lecturer cannot join a class
classes_join_class_body: {lecturer} teaches this class. Each student starts with {cash} in virtual cash.
classes_student_name_hint: Your lecturer sees this name next to your work.
classes_existing_account_link: Sign in with the account that you have
classes_username_taken_error: The field "{field}" holds "{username}", but another account has this username. Choose another one, such as this username with a number at its end.
accounts_privacy_attempts_body: A username that someone typed with a wrong password, in memory only, for {minutes} minutes after each wrong password for it, to stop anyone from guessing the password of an account.
trading_lots_too_many_error: The field "{field}" takes at most {maximum}, the largest order that IDX accepts, but it holds "{value}". Choose at most {maximum}, and trade more lots in further orders.
trading_lots_too_few_error: The field "{field}" needs at least {minimum}, the smallest order, but it holds "{value}". Choose at least {minimum}.
trading_new_order_error: Place a new order if you still want {code}, and Portolab checks it at the price and with the cash of that moment.
classes_new_accounts_blocked_error: Portolab creates no account from your network until {time} WIB, because it received {accounts} requests for a new account from it within {minutes} minutes. The limit stops anyone who tries to flood a class with accounts. Try again after that time, or join through another network, such as the mobile data of your phone.
classes_lecturer_only_error: Only lecturers create a class, and you are signed in as a student. To teach a class, ask the person who runs this Portolab server for a lecturer account.
classes_lecturer_only_title: A student cannot create a class
trading_shares_gone_error: Portolab did not fill your order to sell {lots} of {code}, because when a price reached it, you held {held} of {code}.
trading_fill_notice: Portolab fills an order at a delayed price from {source}, about {minutes} minutes behind IDX, that was quoted in session I or session II of the trading day of the order. So a fill can differ from the price on the exchange at the same moment.
trading_prices_link: See the delayed prices of the stocks
trading_one_sale_sets_aside_notice: Your open sell order sets aside {shares} of this holding.
trading_several_sales_set_aside_notice: Your {count} open sell orders set aside {shares} of this holding.
trading_day_notice: An order that you place now can fill at a delayed price quoted in session I or session II on {date}, from {start} WIB, and it expires at {end} WIB if it has not filled by then.
trading_stock_hint: You can buy a stock of the LQ45 that has the monthly returns that the measures of a portfolio need, and sell a stock that you hold.
trading_lots_hint: A lot is {shares}. An order has {smallest} to {largest}, the largest order that IDX accepts.
trading_limit_price_hint: In whole rupiah. Only a limit order uses it. A purchase fills at this price or lower, and a sale at this price or higher.
trading_placed_notice: Portolab accepted your order, and your orders below show where it stands.
trading_no_stock_error: The field "{field}" holds no stock yet. Choose the stock of the order.
trading_unknown_stock_error: The form sent "{value}" in the field "{field}", but Portolab trades only the stocks in the list of that field. Reload the page and choose one of them.
trading_no_choice_error: The field "{field}" holds no choice yet. Choose {choices}.
trading_unknown_choice_error: The form sent "{value}" in the field "{field}", but the field takes only {choices}. Reload the page and choose one of them.
trading_limit_not_whole_error: The field "{field}" takes a price in whole rupiah, such as {example}, but it holds "{value}". Write the price in digits, with or without "{separator}" between groups of digits as the example shows.
trading_no_past_orders_body: None of your orders has ended yet.
trading_market_purchase_title: Buy {lots} of {code} at the market price
trading_limit_purchase_title: Buy {lots} of {code} at a limit of {limit}
trading_market_sale_title: Sell {lots} of {code} at the market price
trading_limit_sale_title: Sell {lots} of {code} at a limit of {limit}
trading_placed_at_notice: Placed on {time} WIB for the trading day {date}.
trading_waiting_notice: It waits for a delayed price of {code} from session I or session II.
trading_resting_notice: It rests at its limit, because the delayed prices of its sessions have not reached the limit yet. It fills at its limit once a price reaches it.
trading_purchase_sets_aside_notice: It sets aside {cash} of your cash.
trading_expires_notice: It expires at {time} WIB if it has not filled by then.
trading_purchase_filled_notice: Filled at {price}, a delayed price quoted on {time} WIB. It cost {cost}, which is {value} for the shares and {fee} for the broker fee.
trading_sale_filled_notice: Filled at {price}, a delayed price quoted on {time} WIB. It brought {proceeds}, which is {value} for the shares less {fee} for the broker fee and {tax} for the final tax on sales.
trading_expired_notice: It expired without filling when the delayed prices of {date} became final at {time} WIB.
trading_rejected_notice: Rejected on {time} WIB, at a delayed price quoted on {quotedTime} WIB.
trading_order_ended_error: Your order of {lots} of {code} placed on {time} WIB is no longer open, so Portolab cannot cancel it. Your past orders below show how it ended.
trading_missing_order_error: Portolab holds no such order among your orders, so it cancelled nothing. The list below shows each open order that you can cancel.
trading_one_other_sale_set_aside_error: Your other open sell order set aside {setAside} of {code} then.
trading_several_other_sales_set_aside_er: Your {count} other open sell orders set aside {setAside} of {code} then.
trading_check_holdings_error: Check the shares that you hold now in your holdings above before you sell again.
trading_rules_missing_notice: Portolab cannot take an order now, because it has not recorded the rules of IDX for the trading day of an order that you place now. Tell your lecturer, so that the rules can be added.
trading_costs_missing_notice: Portolab cannot take an order now, because it lacks a record of the broker fee or of the final tax on sales for the trading day of an order that you place now. Tell your lecturer, so that the missing rates can be added.
